name: Shimla–Manali Explorer
description: A carefully curated journey through the scenic landscapes of Himachal Pradesh. Covering the charming hill stations of Shimla and Manali, this tour blends natural beauty, cultural heritage, and light adventure.
route: Delhi → Shimla → Kufri → Manali → Kullu Valley → Solang Valley → Delhi
highlights: Scenic drive through the picturesque Kullu Valley
Visit to heritage sites and temples in Shimla
Excursion to Kufri and nearby scenic viewpoints
Exploration of Manali's cultural and spiritual landmarks
Visit to Solang Valley and nearby high-altitude regions

itinerary.title: Delhi to Shimla
itinerary.desc: Picked up from Delhi and driven to Shimla. Visit Wildflower Hall, Indira Holiday Home, and the Advance Study & Museum. Overnight stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Shimla & Kufri Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: Explore Shimla attractions including Kalibari Temple, Jakhu Temple, Sankat Mochan Temple, and Christ Church. Visit Kufri for scenic views. Optional horse riding. Overnight in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Shimla to Manali
itinerary.desc: Drive to Manali through the beautiful Kullu Valley. Enjoy views of the Beas River and visit Dashehra Maidan. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali Local Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: Visit Hadimba Devi Temple, Manu Temple, Vashisht Temple, and Tibetan Monastery. Evening at leisure. Overnight in Manali.

itinerary.title: Excursion to Solang Valley / Rohtang Region
itinerary.desc: Full-day excursion to Solang Valley, Kothi, Gulaba, and Marhi. Possibility of Rohtang Pass visit (extra cost). Overnight in Manali.

itinerary.title: Departure to Delhi
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, check out and drive back to Delhi. End of trip.

inclusions: Daily breakfast and dinner at hotels
Pick-up and drop from Delhi (airport/railway station)
Private vehicle for all transfers and sightseeing
Shimla and Manali local tours as per itinerary
exclusions: Airfare or train tickets to/from Delhi
Any service not specifically mentioned in inclusions
essentialTips: Weather may vary; pack warm clothing
Optional activities like horse riding and snow sports are extra
